note: Internal Phase 0 audit output. Every recommendedWording value is an unapproved internal proposal and requires human copy approval before any implementation.

classificationNotes.Verified: Repository evidence fully supports the claim.
classificationNotes.Needs qualification: True in a narrower sense than the wording implies, or open to a broader reading than intended.
classificationNotes.Not yet supportable: Repository evidence does not establish the claim.
classificationNotes.Founder assertion: A first-person biographical statement. Not a product claim and not classified against repository evidence, because the repository cannot confirm or refute it. Requires founder confirmation. Excluded from the evidence-based classification totals.

claims.wording: Completely free
claims.intendedMeaning: No charge and no paid tier.
claims.repositoryEvidence: No payment code, pricing, or paywall anywhere. JSON-LD asserts isAccessibleForFree true and offers.price 0 (index.html:54-55).
claims.riskReason: Accurate, but drifts from the approved proof point 'Genuinely free' already used on every generated page.
claims.recommendedWording: Genuinely free

claims.wording: Po polsku is completely free, requires no account, and keeps your learning progress on your device.
claims.intendedMeaning: Summary of the free, no-account, local-storage position.
claims.repositoryEvidence: Consistent with C-001, C-004, C-016.
claims.riskReason: Same terminology drift as C-001.
claims.recommendedWording: Po polsku is genuinely free, requires no account, and keeps your learning progress on your device.

claims.wording: Genuinely free. No account. Works offline.
claims.intendedMeaning: Compact proof-point line closing every generated page.
claims.repositoryEvidence: Free and no-account are verified. Offline is qualified: see C-005.
claims.contradictoryEvidence: Generated pages themselves are not precached and are unavailable offline before first visit (sw.js:908-911).
claims.riskReason: The offline third of the line is displayed on the surface where it is least true, and for a search visitor a generated page may be the only surface ever seen.
claims.recommendedWording: Remove the offline phrase from the generated-page ending: 'Genuinely free. No account required.'
alternativeMitigations: RECOMMENDED DEFAULT: remove the offline phrase from the generated-page ending - 'Genuinely free. No account required.' No short phrase in that position can be made accurate.
ACCEPTED ALTERNATIVE: keep an offline mention only alongside an adjacent precise explanation of first-visit behaviour, generated-page caching, and pronunciation-clip caching.

REJECTED: 'Works offline once installed.' It reads as a guarantee that installation delivers offline availability, which is contradicted by three facts: previously unplayed pronunciation clips still require a connection (sw.js:923); generated pages are not precached before a first visit (sw.js:908-911); and installation alone does not make every generated URL or clip available offline.
claims.implementationNote: Single string at build_pages.py:628 that regenerates all 31 pages. Scheduled in Phase 3 rather than Phase 1 because any generator run rewrites all generated outputs and resets sitemap lastmod dates.
claims.detailedQualificationLocation: Install and Privacy screens, where there is room to state all three limits accurately. The generated-page ending should not attempt to carry the detail.

claims.wording: No account needed
claims.intendedMeaning: No registration or sign-in is required.
claims.repositoryEvidence: No authentication code, no sign-in UI, no user identifier. Progress stored in localStorage under popolsku-* keys (pp-migrate.js:27-33).
claims.riskReason: Fully supported.
claims.recommendedWording: No change required.

claims.wording: works offline
claims.intendedMeaning: The app is usable without a network connection.
claims.repositoryEvidence: REQUIRED_ASSETS precaches the document, four helper scripts, seven data files and the audio manifest; install fails if any required asset cannot be stored (sw.js:81-95, sw.js:716).
claims.contradictoryEvidence: MP3s are never precached and are cache-first at runtime only (sw.js:923). Generated pages are never precached and redirect to root on an offline miss (sw.js:908-911). Offline capability begins only after a first successful online visit.
claims.riskReason: A learner who installs and then goes offline will find unplayed pronunciation clips silent, which is the product's headline feature. This is the one register entry where the gap is functional rather than terminological.
claims.recommendedWording: After your first visit the app works offline. Pronunciation clips are saved as you play them, so clips you have not played yet need a connection the first time.
claims.generatedPageCoverage: Clarifying only Install and Privacy would leave the claim unqualified on the 31 generated pages, which are the surfaces a search visitor sees first and are themselves not precached. See C-003: the recommended default is to remove the offline phrase from the generated-page ending rather than qualify it, because no short phrase in that position is accurate.
claims.externalVerification: Requires physical-device verification of real offline behaviour.

claims.wording: One tap to open, works offline.
claims.intendedMeaning: Install banner value proposition.
claims.repositoryEvidence: Install path verified in sw.js.
claims.riskReason: Sets an offline expectation at the moment of install without stating the audio limit.
claims.recommendedWording: Defer detail to the Install screen; keep the banner short.

claims.wording: Polish flashcards with Polish pronunciation audio
claims.intendedMeaning: The app supplies pronunciation audio for Polish phrases.
claims.repositoryEvidence: verify_audio.py confirms 3,377 required phrases, 3,377 manifest entries, 3,377 MP3s, 0 missing, 0 orphaned.
claims.riskReason: Exactly matches approved audio terminology. Should be protected from drift.
claims.recommendedWording: No change. Treat as canonical phrasing.

claims.wording: Free Polish flashcards with audio for A1-B1
claims.intendedMeaning: PWA description.
claims.repositoryEvidence: Audio coverage verified.
claims.contradictoryEvidence: Only public surface that drops 'pronunciation' from the approved phrase; index.html:50 uses the full form for the same sentence.
claims.riskReason: Terminology inconsistency, not inaccuracy.
claims.recommendedWording: Free Polish flashcards with Polish pronunciation audio for A1-B1
claims.implementationNote: manifest.json is precached; changing it requires a shell CACHE bump.

claims.wording: Pronunciation normally uses pre-recorded audio provided with the app.
claims.intendedMeaning: Clips ship with the app rather than being generated on demand.
claims.repositoryEvidence: 3,377 MP3s ship with the app, so 'provided with the app' is accurate. audio-manifest.json declares voice 'pl-PL-MarekNeural', a synthetic neural text-to-speech voice, so the clips are generated in advance rather than captured in a recording session.
claims.contradictoryEvidence: None establishing falsity. A synthetic clip generated in advance can accurately be described as pre-recorded or pre-generated. The issue is that 'pre-recorded' is ambiguous and open to a human-recording inference, and it drifts from the approved terminology used on every other surface.
claims.riskReason: Ambiguous provenance terminology open to a narrower reading than the process supports, plus an internal consistency gap against the approved wording 'pronunciation-audio clip'. Not an established provenance misrepresentation.
claims.recommendedWording: Pronunciation normally plays a pronunciation-audio clip supplied with the app. If a clip cannot play, the app may use your browser's built-in speech feature, which is controlled by your browser or device.

claims.wording: If a clip cannot play, the app may use your browser's built-in speech feature. That fallback is controlled by your browser or device.
claims.intendedMeaning: Disclosure of the speech-synthesis fallback.
claims.repositoryEvidence: Fallback implemented at index.html:3193 and 3215-3236; generated pages at build_pages.py:311-327.
claims.contradictoryEvidence: Understates that some platform speech engines process text server-side.
claims.riskReason: Accurate and appropriately placed; completeness could improve.
claims.recommendedWording: Optionally note that browser speech engines may process text on their own servers.
claims.externalVerification: Requires legal review on whether explicit disclosure is required.

claims.wording: I review and improve the content continuously, with help from native Polish speakers around me, including my teacher.
claims.intendedMeaning: Informal quality help from Polish speakers known to the founder.
claims.repositoryEvidence: validate_content.py recognises review-ticket and review-reference metadata (validate_content.py:33-36), showing a review mechanism exists.
claims.contradictoryEvidence: None establishing falsity. The repository holds no record of what was reviewed, how much was covered, or when, so it cannot characterise the scope of the help. The claim names no particular person: 'my teacher' is a relationship, not an identity. It asserts no partnership, professional review, or endorsement. The repository cannot establish whether permission to mention this was requested or granted, and absence of consent evidence in a code repository is not evidence that consent was absent; no inference about consent is drawn.
claims.riskReason: Scope and coverage of the help are undocumented, and the wording is open to a broader reading than intended: a visitor may infer more systematic external review than the repository can evidence.
claims.recommendedWording: I review and improve the content continuously. New major content releases follow a structured linguistic and audio-review process.
claims.recommendationRationale: Process-based wording is clearer, does not depend on any individual relationship, and stays accurate as the content grows.
claims.externalVerification: Requires founder confirmation of what the help actually consists of, if a people-based framing is preferred over the process wording.

claims.wording: I review and improve the content continuously
claims.intendedMeaning: Ongoing maintenance of content quality.
claims.repositoryEvidence: validate_content.py (150 KB deterministic validator), 149 Python tests, 32 JavaScript suites (9,535 assertions), frozen forward baseline covering 1,675 ids / 13,387 wording / 1,312 policy / 1,777 structure entries.
claims.riskReason: Well substantiated by systematic safeguards.
claims.recommendedWording: Retain; pair with the approved process wording instead of the teacher reference.

claims.wording: It has grown into a practical learning app with vocabulary, grammar, listening, typing, mixed quizzes, conversations, and pronunciation audio.
claims.intendedMeaning: Feature inventory.
claims.repositoryEvidence: All seven exist: 1,215 vocabulary cards, 353 grammar drills, synthetic Listening and Type it levels (index.html:1846-1847), mixed round screen (index.html:1469), 8 conversation scenarios, 3,377 audio clips.
claims.riskReason: Every named feature exists.
claims.recommendedWording: No change required.

claims.wording: I'm a foreigner living in Poland, learning Polish while studying for a master's degree
claims.intendedMeaning: Founder biography.
claims.repositoryEvidence: None applicable. The repository contains no biographical records, and no attempt was made to verify the founder's biography from repository contents; that would be neither possible nor appropriate for a code audit.
claims.riskReason: Not a product claim. The framing correctly separates founder biography from factual product claims by voice and placement, and that separation should be preserved.
claims.recommendedWording: No change to the framing. Confirm the statement remains current at publication time.
claims.externalVerification: Requires founder confirmation that the statement remains current, for example that the master's study is still accurate.

claims.wording: Po polsku does not use advertising, marketing cookies, or analytics tools.
claims.intendedMeaning: No advertising, tracking, or analytics.
claims.repositoryEvidence: Zero occurrences of document.cookie; no analytics SDK; no third-party scripts; no iframes or embeds. Only external hosts referenced anywhere are youtube.com, patreon.com, realpolish.pl (user-initiated links) and schema.org (JSON-LD namespace URI). CSP default-src 'self' with connect-src 'self' (index.html:38) structurally blocks third-party connections.
claims.riskReason: Fully supported and structurally enforced. The product's strongest trust asset.
claims.recommendedWording: No change. Consider stating the CSP guarantee as an additional strength.

claims.wording: Your progress, known words, and app settings are stored locally in your browser on this device.
claims.intendedMeaning: Learning data never leaves the device.
claims.repositoryEvidence: localStorage only. No IndexedDB anywhere. No sessionStorage (index.html:4256 is a comment stating it is deliberately not used). Nine keys enumerated in the privacy audit.
claims.riskReason: Accurate.
claims.recommendedWording: No change required.

claims.wording: The site is delivered through GitHub Pages and Cloudflare, which may process standard technical request data needed to deliver and protect the site.
claims.intendedMeaning: Naming hosting processors.
claims.repositoryEvidence: CNAME contains popolsku.app, consistent with GitHub Pages custom-domain hosting.
claims.contradictoryEvidence: Cloudflare presence cannot be verified from the repository.
claims.riskReason: Naming a processor that may not be in the delivery path is a factual error in the document users most rely on for trust.
claims.recommendedWording: Confirm the actual delivery path and name only confirmed processors.
claims.externalVerification: Requires live-browser verification of response headers.

claims.wording: A backup downloads a JSON file containing your Po polsku progress and app data to a location you choose.
claims.intendedMeaning: Backups capture the user's data.
claims.repositoryEvidence: buildBackupEnvelope produces app, version, schemaVersion, exported timestamp and a data map (pp-migrate.js:404-412). No network transmission; no name, email, or device identifier.
claims.contradictoryEvidence: ppBackupData copies only keys prefixed 'popolsku-' (index.html:5176-5181). The card-direction preference is stored as 'pp-card-dir' and is therefore excluded from every backup.
claims.riskReason: 'app data' overstates coverage by one cosmetic preference; no progress is lost.
claims.recommendedWording: Narrow to 'your progress and settings saved under Po polsku's own storage keys', or fix the key prefix in a later phase.

claims.wording: Po polsku is designed to help you learn Polish without requiring an account or building a learner profile.
claims.intendedMeaning: No account and no profiling.
claims.repositoryEvidence: No identifier is generated, stored or transmitted. Persisted values are progress, speed preference, a one-time voice-hint flag, install-prompt state, and card direction.
claims.riskReason: Accurate; also acts as a binding constraint on any future measurement.
claims.recommendedWording: No change required.

claims.wording: These are personal recommendations. None of the creators paid to be included here.
claims.intendedMeaning: Disclosure that recommendations are unpaid and personal.
claims.repositoryEvidence: The four outbound links carry no affiliate parameters, no tracking parameters, and no sponsorship markup (guide/listening/index.html:126).
claims.contradictoryEvidence: The absence of affiliate or tracking parameters does NOT prove the absence of a commercial or review relationship; money, agreements and reviews leave no trace in static markup. The repository cannot establish whether any creator paid to be included, whether any creator is currently a partner, whether any creator has reviewed any part of the app, whether any creator has endorsed the app, or whether any creator is aware of their inclusion. The published sentence 'None of the creators paid to be included here' is therefore a factual assertion resting on founder knowledge, not on code.
claims.riskReason: The disclosure does not address what a reader may infer about partnership or endorsement, and its existing payment statement is not verifiable from the repository.
claims.recommendedWording: These are personal recommendations. None of the creators paid to be included. Inclusion here does not indicate a formal partnership with Po polsku or an endorsement of the app.
claims.externalVerification: Requires founder confirmation on three separate questions: (1) that no creator paid to be included; (2) each creator's actual relationship status; (3) whether each creator is aware of their inclusion. Question (3) is independent of the wording and does not block it.
claims.recommendationRationale: Implication-based wording. The third sentence states what inclusion means, which is within the founder's authority to state. The first two sentences remain factual assertions requiring founder confirmation.
rejectedWording: none of them is a partner
none of them has reviewed or endorsed the app
any categorical statement about a third party's relationship or activity, unless separately confirmed
claims.rejectedWordingReason: Asserts knowledge about other people that neither the repository nor necessarily the founder possesses, and is a stronger claim than the disclosure needs.
claims.phaseReason: The string lives in build_pages.py:914, so it is deferred with all other generator-dependent work (R-12).

deliberatelyAbsentClaims.reason: Would misdescribe the process: the manifest voice is pl-PL-MarekNeural, a synthetic neural TTS voice.
Forbidden by Phase 0. C-011 does not make this claim, but its current wording is open to being read that way.
Would create a permanent maintenance obligation.
Extensive a11y test coverage exists but conformance is not certified.

deliberatelyAbsentClaims.claim: partnership or collaboration with a named party
